# Grant and Associates

> Media, presentation and public speaking coaching and training for executives, public figures and on-air talent, built on each speaker's strengths. Founded in 1997 by Judy Grant.

Principal: Judy Grant. Judy Grant brought two decades of experience in front of and behind the camera to the training of business professionals, public figures and on-air talent. Her award-winning career covers all facets of news media, from reporting and television news anchoring to program management and producing. She founded Grant and Associates in 1997. Phone: 510.523.1112. Contact: https://grantandassociates.com/contact/

## About

- [About Judy Grant](https://grantandassociates.com/about/): Grant and Associates provides media, presentation and public speaking training for C-level and business executives, public figures, and corporate spokespeople. Founded in 1997 by Judy Grant.
- [Speaking for Impact®](https://grantandassociates.com/speaking-for-impact/): Improve your speaking skills by identifying and leveraging your Speaking Strengths in a Speaking for Impact® seminar for your team.
- [Clients](https://grantandassociates.com/clients/)

## Coaching and training

- [Accent Reduction](https://grantandassociates.com/coaching-training/accent-reduction/): Accent reduction training, a valuable investment for tapping the full potential of non-native English speakers.
- [Coaching for Celebrities](https://grantandassociates.com/coaching-training/celebrities/): Project composure and confidence with media and presentation coaching for celebrities, athletes, authors and public figures.
- [Custom Workshops](https://grantandassociates.com/coaching-training/custom-workshops/): Customize a workshop to give your team the public speaking, presentation and media training they need.
- [Executive Coaching](https://grantandassociates.com/coaching-training/executive-coaching/): Private media and presentation coaching for high-profile executives and individuals frequently in the spotlight.
- [Media Training](https://grantandassociates.com/coaching-training/media-training/): Take control of every media interaction with media training for executives and high-profile individuals.
- [Presentation Training](https://grantandassociates.com/coaching-training/presentation-training/): Identify and amplify your team's speaking strengths with a Presentation Training workshop.
- [Speechwriting](https://grantandassociates.com/coaching-training/speechwriting/): Professional speechwriting services to help you deliver a powerful and effective speech.
- [Teleprompter Training](https://grantandassociates.com/coaching-training/teleprompter/): Effective use of a teleprompter allows you to fully connect with your audience. Learn how to use a teleprompter.
- [On-Camera Coaching for TV Talent](https://grantandassociates.com/coaching-training/tv-talent/): Coaching for on-camera personalities who'd like to develop a connection with the viewer that conveys intimacy, trust and likeability.

## Who we serve

- [Executives](https://grantandassociates.com/who-we-serve/executives/): Elevate your speaking skills and develop your media savvy with private executive coaching.
- [Human Resources](https://grantandassociates.com/who-we-serve/human-resources/): Give your executives and company the edge through public speaking, media and presentation coaching and training.
- [PR Firms](https://grantandassociates.com/who-we-serve/pr-firms/): Ensure your clients get the most from every media and speaking opportunity with media and presentation coaching and training.
- [TV Stations](https://grantandassociates.com/who-we-serve/tv-stations/): Connect your on-air talent with their audience through professional coaching.
